summary: Transaction 3447112 for $350.02 on card C11965-K1 was flagged by the bank's second-generation fraud model with an elevated score of 0.994. Investigation revealed that the transaction was executed on device D002318, which is linked to 13 confirmed-fraud closed cases across 13 distinct cards in September 2016. Card C11965-K1 also has three prior confirmed-fraud closed cases from August and September 2016, and the transaction amount represents an anomalous spike with no recurring baseline. Based on the connection to known fraudulent device infrastructure and compromised card history, the transaction is determined to be card-not-present fraud. The card has been blocked and a regulatory report filed.
open_question: Direct customer verification confirming whether they authorized transaction 3447112 would provide final confirmation. While device D002318 is tied to 13 confirmed fraud cases in September 2016, its generic browser and OS profile and 7-week gap in activity leave a slight residual uncertainty regarding device collision or re-assignment.
